verification.reason: Two-stage fix in manager.resumeSession(): commit 18361c29 suppressed already-terminal sessions (done/error/interrupted in DB). context.root_cause: The auto-resume subscriber listens to session.end events with status=interrupted. Three race conditions cause noise: (1) sessions complete and are cleaned from registry before resume (handled by commit 18361c29), (2) sessions don't exist in DB at all — pre-creation races where session.end events arrive before session creation (handled by 6d7c493d), (3) sessions show 'running' in DB but not in registry — zombie rows from crashes (handled by 6d7c493d).
context.evidence: 59 session.resume_failed events in 4h (sustained ~5-9 per 10min), all session_not_found category, all unique session IDs (no retry spirals), predominantly aks-rp-e2e planner/task sessions.

(4) platform-owner-review.ts now tracks and marks consumed message.created event IDs as handled via markInboxHandled(), closing the owner-workflow lifecycle gap. QueryAPI extended with markInboxHandled() and expireStaleMessages() in query-service.ts, sdk/index.ts, and workflow-defs.d.ts. (5) Follow-up: buildReviewPacket now queries ALL pending owner messages (25h lookback, limit 200, owner=agent:may) for lifecycle marking, not just the 1h display window. This closes the dead zone where messages between 1h-24h old were never marked handled.
